events.title: Gemini 4 Argon announced
events.summary: Google's new frontier model is rolling out first to trusted cyber defenders. Paid API customers and Google AI Ultra subscribers come next; no API date is published yet.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence
sources.excerpt: Today, we're announcing our new frontier model, Gemini 4 Argon, which is rolling out to a set of trusted cyber defenders through our Fairwind Program.

events.title: Google publishes Gemini 4 Argon results on 17 benchmarks
events.summary: Google's launch table compares Gemini 4 Argon with GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5.5 across coding, knowledge work, science, long context, multimodal and security benchmarks.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon (Google DeepMind)
sources.excerpt: Benchmark Notes Gemini 4 Argon GPT-6 Astra Claude Fable 5.1 Claude Opus 5.5 Vals Index Knowledge work 68.9% 63.1% 65.8% 67.0%

events.title: Claude Sonnet 4.5 deprecated
events.summary: Anthropic notified API developers that Claude Sonnet 4.5 retires on November 30, 2026, with Claude Sonnet 5.5 as the recommended replacement.

sources.title: Model deprecations - Claude Platform Docs
sources.excerpt: 2026-09-30: Claude Sonnet 4.5 model On September 30, 2026, Anthropic notified developers using Claude Sonnet 4.5 of its upcoming retirement on the Claude API. Retirement date November 30, 2026 claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 claude-sonnet-5-5

events.title: GPT-6.1 Sol released
events.summary: OpenAI's new Sol model for complex coding and professional work, at a lower cost than GPT-6 Astra. Available in the API and in ChatGPT Work and Codex on paid plans.

sources.title: Changelog | OpenAI API
sources.excerpt: Sep 29 Feature gpt-6.1-sol v1/responses v1/chat/completions Released GPT-6.1 Sol ( gpt-6.1-sol ) for complex coding and professional work at a lower cost than GPT-6 Astra.

sources.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Sol
sources.excerpt: Its standard API prices are $2 per million input tokens, $0.10 per million cached input tokens, and $10 per million output tokens.

sources.title: GPT-6.1 Sol Model | OpenAI API
sources.excerpt: 1,050,000 context window 128,000 max output tokens

events.title: ChatGPT Pro 500 launched at $500 a month
events.summary: A third Pro tier with the highest included usage of the Pro plans and Astra Ultrafast in ChatGPT Work and Codex. Pro 100 and Pro 200 remain.

sources.title: ChatGPT - Release Notes
sources.excerpt: We're introducing Pro 500, a new $500/month plan with the highest included usage of the Pro plans and access to Astra Ultrafast in ChatGPT Work and Codex.

sources.title: About ChatGPT Pro tiers
sources.excerpt: ChatGPT Pro now offers Pro 500, a new $500/month plan that includes Astra Ultrafast. Pro 200 is also available for new subscriptions again. New subscriptions that aren't eligible for grandfathering include a lower usage allowance.

events.title: ChatGPT Pro 200 reopens with a lower usage allowance
events.summary: New subscribers can join Pro 200 again at $200 a month, with less included usage than before. Subscribers eligible for grandfathering keep the previous allowance through October 29.

sources.title: About ChatGPT Pro tiers
sources.excerpt: Yes. New Pro 200 subscriptions are available from the pricing page. New subscriptions that aren't eligible for grandfathering include a lower usage allowance than previously offered with Pro 200 to reflect our increasingly efficient models. The monthly price remains $200.

sources.title: ChatGPT - Release Notes
sources.excerpt: Pro 200 subscriptions: Pro 200 is available for new subscriptions again at $200/month. Included usage allowances are changing.

events.title: GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast added to the API
events.summary: A faster service tier for GPT-6 Astra: up to 6x faster generation in the API and up to 8x in Codex. In ChatGPT it is limited to Pro 500 and Enterprise.

sources.title: Changelog | OpenAI API
sources.excerpt: Sep 29 Feature gpt-6-astra v1/responses Added Ultrafast mode for GPT-6 Astra in the Responses API.

sources.title: DevDay 2026 Recap
sources.excerpt: Ultrafast offers up to 8x faster token generation (300 tokens per second) in Codex and up to 6x in the API.

events.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 released
events.summary: Anthropic's new mid-tier model, priced the same as Sonnet 5 and available on the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry.

sources.title: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5.5
sources.excerpt: Sonnet 5.5 is priced the same as Sonnet 5 at $2 per million input tokens, $10 per million output tokens, and $0.20 per million tokens for cache reads, but it typically needs far fewer tokens to do the same work.

sources.title: Model deprecations - Claude Platform Docs
sources.excerpt: claude-sonnet-5-5 Active N/A Not sooner than September 28, 2027

events.title: Anthropic publishes Claude Sonnet 5.5 launch results
events.summary: Anthropic's launch results for Sonnet 5.5 include Terminal-Bench 4.0, where it reports 70.6% against Sonnet 5's 10.3%.

sources.title: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5.5
sources.excerpt: Sonnet 5.5 scores 70.6% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, an agentic coding evaluation, compared to Sonnet 5’s 10.3%.

events.title: Claude Opus 5.5 released
events.summary: Anthropic's new flagship. Input and output cost 20% less than Opus 5, and cache reads, most of the cost of agentic coding, 60% less.

sources.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5.5
sources.excerpt: Input and output tokens are $4 and $20 per million, 20% less than Opus 5. Cache reads (which make up the majority of agentic and coding work costs) are $0.20 per million tokens, 60% less than Opus 5.

sources.title: Claude API Release Notes
sources.excerpt: September 22, 2026 ... On Claude Opus 5.5, thinking can't be disabled: thinking: {"type": "disabled"} and thinking: {"type": "enabled", ...} return a 400 error.

events.title: Claude raises five-hour usage limits on paid plans
events.summary: Alongside Opus 5.5, Anthropic increased five-hour usage limits on Pro, Max, Team and seat-based Enterprise plans, and gave subscribers a rate-limit reset they can save and use later.

sources.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5.5
sources.excerpt: In addition to the price drop, we're increasing five-hour usage limits on Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans. We're also providing subscription users a rate limit reset, which you can now save and use whenever you choose.

events.title: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna released
events.summary: OpenAI's new Sol and Luna models, with API prices 50% below GPT-5.6 Sol and Luna's promotional pricing.

sources.title: Changelog | OpenAI API
sources.excerpt: Sep 22 Feature gpt-6-sol gpt-6-luna v1/responses v1/chat/completions Released GPT-6 Sol ( gpt-6-sol ) and GPT-6 Luna ( gpt-6-luna ).

sources.title: Introducing GPT-6 Sol and Luna
sources.excerpt: GPT-5.6 Sol to GPT-6 Sol $4 to $2 / $20 to $10 50% cheaper. GPT-5.6 Luna to GPT-6 Luna $0.20 to $0.10 / $1.20 to $0.50 50% cheaper. Prices are per 1 million tokens.

events.title: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6 Pro and Flash released with open weights
events.summary: Xiaomi released and open-sourced the MiMo-V2.6 series, two multimodal models at the same API pricing as V2.5.

events.title: Grok 4.7 released
events.summary: xAI's new frontier model for coding, agentic tasks and knowledge work, now on the xAI API with a 500K context window.

sources.title: Release Notes | xAI Docs
sources.excerpt: September 21 Grok 4.7 Grok 4.7, SpaceXAI's frontier model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work, is now available on the xAI API as grok-4.7 . It has a 500k context window, text and image inputs with text-only output, and no text output limit. Pricing is $2 / $0.50 / $6 per 1M tokens

sources.title: Introducing Grok 4.7
sources.excerpt: Sep 21, 2026 ... The model is priced starting at $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens. We also serve a fast variant with twice the output speed at twice the price.

events.title: xAI publishes Grok 4.7 launch results
events.summary: xAI's launch table reports Grok 4.7 on CursorBench 4.0, DeepSWE v1.1, EEBench, Terminal-Bench 4.0 and HealthBench Professional, among others.

sources.title: Introducing Grok 4.7
sources.excerpt: Token prices and benchmark scores for Grok 4.7, Grok 4.6, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Fable 5.1.

events.title: Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash released
events.summary: Qwen's next native omni-modal model takes text, image, audio and video input with up to 1M tokens of context, on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio.

sources.title: Changelog | QwenCloud Docs
sources.excerpt: September 18, 2026 ... qwen3.8-omni-flash Qwen's next-generation native omni-modal model supports context lengths of up to 1M tokens and natively accepts text, image, audio, and video inputs.

events.title: ChatGPT Pro 200 pauses new sign-ups
events.summary: OpenAI paused new sign-ups and upgrades to the $200 Pro plan. Existing Pro 200 and Pro 100 subscriptions were not affected.

sources.title: About ChatGPT Pro tiers (OpenAI Help Center), archived Sep 19, 2026
sources.excerpt: As of September 10, 2026, we're temporarily pausing new sign-ups and upgrades to the ChatGPT Pro $200 plan (Pro 20X).

events.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash released
events.summary: DeepSeek's first model in a new architecture family, with native visual understanding, a 1M-token context and open weights.

sources.title: Change Log | DeepSeek API Docs
sources.excerpt: Date: 2026-09-10 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Release Today, we officially release the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model. It is the smallest model in our new architecture family, with native multimodal visual understanding.

sources.title: Introducing DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
sources.excerpt: 552B-parameter MoE. New Causal Encoder-Decoder architecture: just 8B active parameters for input, 16B for output.

events.title: DeepSeek lowers API prices with V4.1-Flash
events.summary: DeepSeek cut its API prices with the V4.1-Flash release, effective 04:00 UTC on September 10. Off-peak rates stay at half the peak rate.

sources.title: Introducing DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
sources.excerpt: More efficient architecture. Lower API prices. ... New pricing takes effect at 04:00 UTC on Sept 10, 2026.

sources.title: Change Log | DeepSeek API Docs
sources.excerpt: API pricing adjustment With the release of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, API prices have been reduced accordingly.

events.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Flash Vision Exp retired

events.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash generally available
